notes: The extraction is thorough and accurate overall. It covers all seven machines, captures nearly every cited figure with verbatim quotes, and handles the source attribution and hypothetical flags sensibly. The main error is the blank-shirt cost: it was carried over as $250–$370 and reinterpreted as an order total, when context shows a per-shirt price of roughly $2.50–$3.70. The fence 'per foot' wording can be resolved arithmetically as $3–$4/ft. The automation scores, the UK scores, and the C evidence rating are reasonable.
